items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) left early after big game (5/150/1); injury not serious, day-to-day, MRI upcoming; would have returned if playoff game.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential limited or sit Week 2.

items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) active after true game-time decision two hours before kickoff; family stayed away due to uncertainty; played 36 snaps, 6/9 for 69 yards.
items.why: Decided late; full practice week but self-assessed readiness.
items.implication: Start with decoy risk but viable WR1 upside post-ACL.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play and confirmed inactive for Week 1 vs Lions after full practice; team easing him back.
items.why: Weekend reports and Rapoport sources; full practice but rest priority.
items.implication: Opens RB opportunities in NO backfield for Week 1 and potentially beyond if managed.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play and confirmed ACTIVE for Cardinals Week 1.
items.why: Weekend status summary; no setback reported.
items.implication: Clears path for RB2 role; start with risk/reward.

items.text: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) OUT with fractured wrist; several weeks expected after further MRI.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth thinned long-term; elevates others.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (chest) left early in Week 1 after solid start (5/82/1); no immediate timeline, watching status.
items.why: Exited third quarter post-hit; Harbaugh no update.
items.implication: Practice watch critical for Week 2; Chargers WR2/3 impact.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE: risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere; team wouldn't activate if major concern.
items.why: Active confirmation + preseason belief despite Cardinals risk.
items.implication: Must-start with upside in new role.

items.text: A.J. Brown (high ankle) no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks; placed on IR.
items.implication: Patriots WR depth hit; long-term bench.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus trim) has realistic chance to miss only one game and return Week 2 vs Chargers; team monitoring feel.
items.implication: Short absence; stash and prepare for quick TE1 return.

items.text: Rome Odunze (calf) expected to play and ACTIVE for Bears Week 1.
items.why: Weekend reports confirmed expected and active.
items.implication: Full WR role available in high-scoring Bears offense.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid over PCL: 74% snaps (42/57), 69% routes on Allen dropbacks; will move needle when healthy.
items.implication: TE1 upside locked with high involvement.

items.text: Jonathan Taylor dominated even in loss: 89% snaps (48/54), 59% routes, 96% RB opportunities (23/24), 13% target share; Colts distrust backups.
items.why: Snap/route/opp data post-game; historical loss struggles overcome by role.
items.implication: Locked-in RB1 volume regardless of game script.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season well underway after strong Week 1 showing.
Buy low on Colston Loveland; still want as much Bears offense as possible despite Week 1 quiet (Kmet/Raymond targets).
items.why: Preseason conviction unchanged by one game.
items.implication: Trade target for TE upside in explosive offense.
